## POST `/api/2.58/realm-connections/connection-keys`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a new one-time connection key to allow establishing a connection to the specified realm. The key is valid until a successful connection is established or its expiration time is reached. Note that this is the only time the connection key is displayed; it cannot be retrieved subsequently.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `context_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the context specified. If specified, the context names must be an array of size 1, and the single element must be the name of an array in the same fleet or the name of the fleet itself. If not… |
| `realm_ids` | query | array of string |  | The comma-separated list of `realm` `IDs`. |
| `realm_names` | query | array of string |  | The unique `realm` `names` on which to perform the operation. Multiple `names` can be entered in a comma-separated format, for example, `realm01,realm02`. |

**Request body** (required): `RealmConnectionKeyPost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | Specifies the type of realm connection that a key can create. Values include async-replication and sync-replication. A sync-replication key can also be used to create an async-replication connection. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `RealmConnectionKeyPostResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.58/realm-connections/connection-keys`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes all connection keys for a given realm. Note that every realm connection key is a one-time key and is deleted automatically upon a successful connection or once it expires.
